g.text: Distribution channels: reach against cost and control
pick the channel the ICP already uses; check its cost against lifetime value
strength: low cost, word of mouth
cost: expensive: CAC can exceed LTV
strength: access to an existing base
strength: reach at scale, new markets
questions: where does the ICP spend time?
what is CAC against LTV? who owns the customer?
can we measure this channel well enough to judge it?
